about: Which param file each LDBC Interactive (SF, query) reads: LDBC's hosted file (a verbatim copy at sf<SF>/interactive_<N>_param.txt, sha256 in sf<SF>/hosted_params.meta.json) or, before rule 2, ours (sf<SF>/ours/interactive_<N>_param.txt, made by data/gen_ic<N>_params.py, provenance in its .meta.json). One source per (SF, query), never mixed; rows are taken as the file gives them. A (SF, query) with no row here is hosted; since rule 2 every row is hosted, and ours/ files stay as records. IS1-3 follow ic1. IS4-7, BI, microbench, IU writes and LinkBench are not LDBC substitution params and are not read from here. Read by python/kvevaluator/datasets/ldbc/params.py (param_file); checked by tests/lint/check_param_sources.py.
rule: always hosted; the census reports stop-early rows, it decides nothing (2026-10-19). The rule: every LDBC Interactive query reads LDBC's hosted params.
